rollups.text: Healthy meal-planning and snack ideas discussed 2023-05-22: Grilled Chicken Fajitas and Chicken and Avocado Salad; make-ahead granola, with sweet-spicy, tropical, nutty, cinnamon-apple, and chocolatey variations; overnight oats, breakfast burritos, muffin-tin frittatas, smoothie packs, cottage-cheese parfaits, prepared avocado toast, and quinoa breakfast bowls; weekend snacks including fruit, nuts and seeds, yogurt parfaits, vegetables with hummus or guacamole, energy balls, hard-boiled eggs, smoothies, and trail mix; sweet snacks including banana nice cream, granola bars, chocolate mousse, cinnamon-apple oat muffins, roasted fruit, chia pudding, baked apples, and protein mug cake; high-protein vegetarian snacks discussed 2023-05-30: hummus and vegetables, roasted chickpeas, Greek yogurt with berries, edamame, apple slices with peanut butter, and trail mix.

Normandy desserts recommended 2023-05-20: Tarte aux Pommes, Teurgoule, and Calvados Soufflé. The user loves apple desserts, chose Tarte aux Pommes to try first, and planned to pair it with an apple cider mimosa.

Photography equipment considered for the user's planned Yellowstone trip: Nikon D500 and 70–200mm lens (planned, 2023-05-22); Nikon MC-36a Multi-Function Remote Cord (user decided it was a worthwhile purchase after trying a remote release at a workshop); compact polarizing filter for the lens (user decided to bring it). A spare Nikon EN-EL15a battery was considered but not definitively chosen.

The user chose 1830 as an entry to the 18xx series and was curious about Locomotive Werks but planned to focus on learning 1830 first. Railroad Revolution was also discussed as a train-game option.

Writing resources included Comedy Writing Secrets, The Comedy Bible, And Here's the Kicker, The Hidden Tools of Comedy, Story, Zen and the Art of Stand-Up Comedy, and I'm Dying Up Here; the user planned to attend a local writing-center comedy workshop on 2023-06-02.
